description: This file defines the ServerRequestCreatorFactory class in the Slim Framework, responsible for creating and determining server request creators, including handling external dependencies and optional decorators.

classes.name: ServerRequestCreatorFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing server request creators within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a server request creator instance.

methods.name: determineServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Determines and returns an appropriate server request creator, throwing an exception if none are available.

methods.name: attemptServerRequestCreatorDecoration
methods.description: Wraps the server request creator with a decorator if available and enabled.

methods.name: setServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Sets the server request creator instance.

methods.name: setSlimHttpDecoratorsAutomaticDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic detection of HTTP decorators.
